To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we propose a novel energy-efficient transmission scheme with/without diversity for energy harvesting cooperative relays.
the energy efficiency of the EH relay system can be optimized with the proposed scheme.
the energy efficiency optimization of the non-Eh source with the help EH DF relaying can be achieved by the proposed EETP.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the EE optimization problem in the EH relay systems and provides an effective solution for the EE improvement of the non-Eh source.
the energy efficiency of the non-Energy Harvesting (non-EH) source with the help from EH relays.
the energy saving and EE optimization of EH cooperative relaying systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the EETP can be a good solution to energy saving and QoS enhancement in the EH relay systems.
the proposed scheme in the paper can help saving energy while meeting the QoS requirement.
the proposed EETP can be a good candidate for future cellular systems with EH relay nodes.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the EE optimization problem of EH relay system with non-ideal circuit is quasiconcave, and the proposed EETP with/without diversity can achieve a good balance between EE and throughput.
the proposed scheme is able to achieve energy saving with the help of EH relaying nodes.
the proposed EETP can achieve the maximum EE of the system and the optimal power allocation can be obtained by a simple bisection method.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is feasible to improve the EE of non-EH source through the help of EH relays.
the EE of the non-Eh source can be improved by the EH relaying nodes, especially in low SNR regime, which is of great significance for future cellular systems with EH nodes.
the energy efficiency of EH cooperative relay system can be improved by the proposed EETP, and the energy saving is significant when the average throughput requirement is not too high.
